name: tpl-not-co-existence-2-nogoal
task: Never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) does not match the task. `key_lost` means dropping the key while the door is closed, but the task forbids that and opening the door from both happening in either order. Since key_lost and door_open cannot be true together, this clause never catches opening the door after a key drop. Use hard Precedence(key_lost, door_open) to forbid opening the door until after the key has not been lost.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: hard NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) captures the task’s prohibition on losing the key while the door is closed and opening the door during the episode.

texts: The key_lost event and opening the door must not both happen during the episode.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!key_lost) -> u2
(u0, door_open&key_lost) -> u3
(u1, door_open) -> u3
(u2, key_lost) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, door_open&key_lost, u3) -> -10
(u1, door_open, u3) -> -10
(u2, key_lost, u3) -> -10
